maraudersMapApp.status: approved design specification; runtime app and animations not yet implemented
maraudersMapApp.placement: existing in-game phone home screen as standalone app
maraudersMapApp.name: 活点地图
maraudersMapApp.visualStyle: Original-book-inspired aged parchment, intricate ink corridors, handwritten names and animated tiny footprints; no modern location pins or avatar markers
opening: Tap app icon to show blank parchment
Display 我庄严宣誓我不干好事 / I solemnly swear that I am up to no good
One tap anywhere on parchment substitutes for speaking the phrase; ink reveals castle map
closing: Display 恶作剧完毕 / Mischief managed
One tap dismisses ink and returns to phone home screen
maraudersMapApp.interaction: No microphone, voice recognition, typing or spoken incantation required

locationTracking.scope: all eight leads, regardless of selected romance route
locationTracking.clock: in-game time; live visual updates while map remains open
locationTracking.sourceOfTruth: shared character timetable, weekly duties, event overrides, free-time movements and player travel time
locationTracking.dormitories: show name stationary in relevant house dormitory area only; never show exact bed or private interior details
locationTracking.transitions: animate footsteps along plausible corridors/stairs and grounds, no instant teleportation
locationTracking.consistency: map position must match actual encounter and story scene at the same game time
locationTracking.privacy: do not show exact bed, shower, or intimate/private activity details

maraudersMapApp.hiddenEvents: Map shows character locations but never event labels, affection opportunities, or trigger hints; player must reach correct place during event window
